hiddenRules.title: Drawdown calculation
hiddenRules.details: Static floor: 6% below starting balance. Touching the floor with balance or equity breaches the account; floating losses count.

hiddenRules.title: Daily-loss reset
hiddenRules.details: 3% of the higher opening balance or equity. Closed and floating losses count. Reset: 00:00 platform time (UTC+3).

hiddenRules.title: Weekend & overnight
hiddenRules.details: Evaluation permits holding. Master positions are automatically closed unless the Swing add-on applies.

hiddenRules.title: Minimum trading days — clarification needed
hiddenRules.details: The official page currently conflicts: its summary says zero days, while purchase/reset cohort notes say one or two. Confirm your dashboard requirement; no automatic minimum-day override is applied.
